title: Residuum Universe Bible: Public Canon Reference
description: Official public canon reference and preservation archive for the Residuum universe by Wesley F. Black, published by Residuum Press. This release preserves the public canon, FREBT matrix, works list, literary-estate continuity instructions, checksums, and the current Residuum Press website source. Canonical website: https://residuumpress.com/. Public repository: https://github.com/specimenHQ/residuum-universe-bible. Current fallback website: https://residuum-press.bwerth32.workers.dev/. Internet Archive preservation record: https://archive.org/details/residuum-universe-bible-public-canon-v1-1.
